|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Nute Gunray's Bounty]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Nute Gunray's Bounty]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 19. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-19-Nute_Gunrays_Bounty.png]]) prints slip number “19” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “sieze” for “seize” (typo as published): “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and sieze that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.”<ref name="cl-1250_19-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-nutegunraysbounty-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual5-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/nutegunraysbounty.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual5-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock5-Dark/large/nutegunraysbounty.gif</ref>: “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 5 set mark) and prints the number “19” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “•Accepting Trade Federation Control (V)”, the label of another card.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 29), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=29, page 29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=29 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-19-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “•Accepting Trade Federation Control (V)”, the label of another card.
